pm_toy_wheat = {
	building_modifiers = {
		workforce_scaled = {
			goods_output_wheat_add = 30
			building_employment_farmers_add = 4000
			building_employment_laborers_add = 1000
		}
	}
}

			goods_output_flour_add = 15
			building_employment_laborers_add = 4000
		}
	}
}

		}
	}
}
